note: デーモン is a context-specific loanword. 悪魔 is the standard Japanese term for a devil or demon; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1152510 sense 0.
幼児 is the standard Japanese equivalent for toddler or young child; the exact age range varies by language and context.
句読点 and chấm câu are natural terms for punctuation symbols and marks that separate clauses and sentences.
cây son refers to a lipstick stick or tube. Son môi is the general Vietnamese term for lipstick makeup.
やかん and ấm are standard equivalents for a kettle used to boil liquid; the cooking use in the definition is an uncommon secondary use.
出てけ and biến are forceful commands to leave, fitting the demanding imperative sense of go away.
tránh means avoid generally. Né is the natural Vietnamese verb for physically dodging or moving suddenly out of the way.
豚 and lợn primarily name domestic pigs, while the supplied English definition spans the entire Suidae family. I found no verified everyday equivalent with that full taxonomic scope.
浮く covers floating generally, including on water. 漂う means drift or float gently through the air or water; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1489240 sense 0.
天 can suggest heaven or a divine realm. 空（そら） is the common unambiguous word for sky; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1245290 sense 0.
コンテンツ usually suggests media or digital content. 内容 means subject matter, substance, or content more generally; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1459400 sense 0.
アザラシ and hải cẩu are standard equivalents for a seal; the common animal sense is clear despite broader zoological classifications of pinnipeds.
点じる is valid but literary. 点火 is the ordinary term for ignition or lighting and is used as a suru-verb; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1441440 sense 0.
信仰的 and sùng đạo both describe commitment or devotion to religious belief and practice; the Japanese form is somewhat formal.
沿う fits the stated sense of meeting or living up to wishes, expectations, and requirements.
指摘 directly means pointing out or identifying something, matching this specific noun sense.
製法 is a standard technical Japanese equivalent for a manufacturing method, recipe, or formula.
漂流する is most commonly drifting at sea or on water. 漂う also covers slow drifting through air; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1489240 sense 0.
強度 is a standard noun for intensity or strength and can describe the degree of an intense quality.
đạn tự hành is technically understandable but uncommon. Tên lửa is the standard everyday Vietnamese word for missile.
じっくり implies doing something slowly as well as carefully. 注意深く means carefully or cautiously without the added slow pace; verified in JMdict ent_seq 2680640 sense 0.
áo choàng can mean a cloak or robe generally. Áo măng tô is a standard Vietnamese term for an overcoat worn over other clothes in cold or wet weather.
強いる means force or compel rather than formally levy or enforce a burden. 課す is directly used for imposing a tax, fine, restriction, or duty; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1195720 sense 0.
一斉に often suggests a group acting in unison. 同時に means occurring at the same time more generally; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1452510 sense 0.
sự đồng lòng can imply stronger unanimity or shared feeling. Sự đồng thuận is the standard Vietnamese noun for general agreement or consensus.
穀粉 is limited to grain flour, while the definition also includes flours from soybeans or potatoes. 粉 has a general flour or meal sense; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1504770 sense 0.
穴 means a hole generally. 巣穴 is a nesting hole, den, or burrow used as an animal home; verified in JMdict ent_seq 2549390 sense 0.
吠える includes the loud animal calls rendered by roar, and gầm is a natural Vietnamese verb for a deep animal roar.
lưỡi dao limits the term to a knife. Lưỡi is the general Vietnamese blade or cutting edge of an instrument such as an axe, sword, or scythe.
ích is uncommon as a standalone Vietnamese noun. Công dụng is natural for usefulness, utility, or purpose.
国内 and nội địa are standard attributive equivalents for internal to a country, as in domestic market or domestic flights.
認める covers admitting a charge or the truth of a committed offense, matching the stated confess sense.
hội thảo often means a seminar or conference. Diễn đàn is the natural Vietnamese equivalent for a discussion forum with presenters and audience participation.
百分率 and số phần trăm are standard equivalents for percentage; the Vietnamese phrase is descriptive but natural.
出品物 can imply an item submitted to an exhibition. 展示品 means an item on display or exhibit more generally; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1943320 sense 0.
gốc is a general root or origin. Từ căn is the Vietnamese linguistic term for a lexical root.
肺 and phổi are used metaphorically for trees or parkland that supply fresh air to a place, as in the green lungs of a city.
アワード is an unnecessary loanword in this general prize sense. 賞 is the standard Japanese word for an award or prize; verified in JMdict ent_seq 1351910 sense 0.
卑しい has a standard vile, mean, or base sense, and đáng khinh means deserving contempt.
沼 and đầm lầy are suitable terms for wet, spongy swamp or marshland; the ecological detail matches the English sense.
